prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Chinese person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, an elegant handsome young male face with a high nose bridge, a defined jaw, straight brows and a strong neck, a very faint trace of stubble, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, smooth light skin with a warm golden undertone, a confident smirk, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a lead cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold necklaces. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Japanese man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, smooth pale skin with a cool undertone, a confident smirk, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead small flared temple bell, a copper chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal ring. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal white leather micro brief of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering him, paired with a black leather chest harness of thin crossing straps with silver ring hardware, his chest and stomach otherwise fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red chunky platform boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
